name: Two In One Manufacturing, Inc.
description: Two In One Manufacturing is dedicated to customer solutions and satisfaction offering quality work and product at a competitive price with high quality, quick turnaround and on-time delivery. As a sub-contract manufacturer, we provide a wide range of services to an array of clients. Our team can support every stage of a customer’s project development. We can provide design, labor, or order fulfillment of high mix low-high volume with quick turn services of lead times varying from one day to 4 weeks with a flexible supply chain. Our services are ideal for clients whose products are too complex for smaller contract manufacturers, clients whose volume does not meet the requirements for larger manufacturing providers from overseas, or simply a customer who needs more collaboration in the early stages of new product development. We give our customers full transparency and completely open communication to provide the best customer service from quote to plan, build test, and delivery. Our current customer base is built from continuous returning clients and referrals from our loyal customers due to our focus on continuous improvement and customer satisfaction.
